Hafiz Abdul Rehman engineered an **Attention U-Net** for 3D MRI brain tumor sub-region segmentation on the **BraTS 2020 dataset**. It integrates soft attention gates to filter irrelevant features and achieved **99.64% validation accuracy** with a **0.986 Mean IoU** across multi-sequence MRI scans.
What visual analytics and supervisions does Hafiz work with?

In **Visual Analytics & Model Telemetry**, Hafiz specializes in translating complex neural manifolds into interactive tools:

- **Interactive Dashboards**: Real-time inference monitors built with Streamlit, Plotly Express, and Next.js.
What student capstone projects has Hafiz supervised?

In **Academic Supervisions & Mentorship**, Hafiz has guided 120+ student engineers and 15+ capstones:
- **Medical Brain Lesion FYP (2024)**: Advised 3 students on 3D Attention U-Net segmentation, achieving 99.4% Dice score.
- **Clinical Decision RAG (2023-2024)**: Mentored 4 students on vector search and reranking, reducing hallucinations by 68%.
